code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows pancytopenia (low leukocytes, neutrophils, platelets), mild anemia, and abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia). There is metabolic acidosis (low pH, low CO₂), mild hypoxemia, elevated INR, high ferritin, and increased alkaline phosphatase. These findings suggest possible bone marrow dysfunction or systemic inflammatory/hematologic disorder. Immediate clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended.
